name: Design flash-sale inventory
strong: Hot-row contention, atomic decrement, queueing/oversell policy, idempotency, rate limiting, reconciliation

name: Design order history for 100M orders
strong: Time/customer access patterns, partitioning, indexes, retention, archival, keyset pagination

name: Design a multi-tenant SaaS database
strong: Tenant key, isolation boundary, row-level security, noisy-neighbour risk, tenant migrations

name: Design a read-heavy catalogue
strong: Cache-aside, CDN, replicas, invalidation, stale-data tolerance, search index if needed

name: Recover from an accidental DELETE
strong: Stop further damage, preserve evidence, restore backup to a separate instance, replay WAL to target time, validate, cut over

name: Handle DB CPU at 95%
strong: Identify query load and waits, top query fingerprints, plans, connection count, locks, cache hit ratio, safe mitigations
